verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official sync service: files appear as a real folder in Finder or Explorer and sync back automatically, and journal entries sync to the Mind folder. Nothing in the evidence shows end-to-end encryption, and the product's server-side parsing, transcription and indexing of files implies the vendor can read content. Missing for 10: end-to-end encryption the vendor can't read, explicit multi-device (including mobile) sync coverage, independent corroboration of sync reliability.
